predeclared_thresholds.validity: termination_condition optimal vs non-optimal; any change is an OUTCOME FLIP
predeclared_thresholds.objective_equivalence: relative |d_obj|/max(1,|obj_base|) <= 1e-6 => equivalent; > 1e-3 => materially different; between => report descriptively, no categorical claim
predeclared_thresholds.primal_solution_equivalence: max_i |x_i - x_base_i| / max(1,|x_base_i|) over the 9166 IPOPT optimization columns; <= 1e-6 equivalent; > 1e-3 materially different; between => descriptive
predeclared_thresholds.branch_regime: declared only if BOTH primal scaled distance > 1e-3 AND relative objective difference > 1e-3; a moderate state difference alone is NOT a branch flip
predeclared_thresholds.path_only: material path change if |d_iterations|/base_iterations > 0.5, OR restoration entries appear/disappear, OR safeguard (z) count changes between zero and nonzero
predeclared_thresholds.rationale: objective/primal thresholds are far tighter than IPOPT tol (1e-5 scaled) and than the project numerical threshold tau_numerical=10 on the planning objective; path threshold chosen as a coarse 50% iteration-count change, declared before any variant result was inspected
